title: AC1024 TABLESTYLE repeated standard identities
scope: Allow R24 TABLESTYLE repeated style records to retain documented standard IDs and the observed raw style-class value zero instead of failing the complete object parse.

evidence.normative: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.101.2: R24 style IDs 1-4 are standard and custom IDs start at 101; the repeated records carry style ID, class and name after cell-style fields.
evidence.independentImplementation: ACadSharp DwgObjectReader.readTableStyle reads the repeated per-style index, cell-style fields, ID, class and name without imposing an ID >= 101 constraint.
evidence.localProducerSample: The existing AC1024 architectural_example-imperial.dwg TABLESTYLE frame (object handle 135) exposed a repeated style identity with ID 1 and raw class 0. The old parser rejected it; the corrected parser reads the sample with zero object parse failures. Class zero remains raw/unmapped because ODA documents only classes 1 and 2.

change.summary: Repeated R24 style identity validation now accepts standard IDs 1-4 as well as custom IDs >=101, and preserves class value 0 alongside documented values 1 and 2 without assigning it semantics.

validation.command: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_reader_matrix_tests libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests dwg2dxf lc3_compat_check -j4
